title: Support for system-level subtitles
product-requirement: Expose the system-level subtitles setting via the OIPF configuration object.
specification: The terminal MUST support the declarative creation of the application/oipfConfiguration object, defined in clause 7.3.1 of OIPF Declarative Application Environment, e.g., <object id="oipfcfg" type="application/oipfConfiguration"></object>.
assertion: When system-level subtitles are enabled, the OIPF configuration object is available and reports subtitlesEnabled as true.
